def test_disable_compression_env(monkeypatch, otlp_http_server):
    base_url, received = otlp_http_server
    monkeypatch.setenv("LANGFUSE_OTEL_DISABLE_COMPRESSION", "true")
    # set other env compression to gzip to test precedence
    monkeypatch.setenv("OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_TRACES_COMPRESSION", "gzip")
    processor = LangfuseSpanProcessor(
        public_key="pk-test",
        secret_key="sk-test",
        base_url=base_url,
    )
    provider = TracerProvider()
    provider.add_span_processor(processor)
    tracer = provider.get_tracer(__name__)
    with tracer.start_as_current_span("test"):
        pass
    provider.shutdown()
    # now request should be sent
    assert len(received) == 1
    req = received[0]
    assert req.content_encoding is None
